description: Verify that DUT-emitted UDP datagrams carry the caller-specified Destination Port (RFC 768 'Fields' MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
The Destination Port determines which application on the receiver picks up the datagram. RFC 768 makes carrying it correctly mandatory — anything else means the message reaches the wrong endpoint or nothing.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: OpTriggerSendUdp request (dst_port = K)

2. Observation:
   • DUT → Tester: UDP datagram
     - dst_port == K   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted UDP carries dst_port = K.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_wrong_dst_port — DUT emitted UDP with a different dst_port
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit any UDP within the listen window

verdicts.Pass: DUT-emitted UDP carries the requested dst_port — normal
verdicts.Fail_wrong_dst_port: DUT emitted UDP with the wrong dst_port
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT-originated UDP within the listen window
